description: This PHP source file defines a Error controller class within the Opencart catalog startup namespace, responsible for handling PHP runtime errors and exceptions in an OpenCart-based e-commerce application.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: A controller class for managing runtime errors and exceptions in the OpenCart catalog startup process. It sets custom error and exception handlers, logs errors, and redirects or displays error messages.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Registers custom error and exception handlers to process errors and exceptions during runtime.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Handles PHP errors by throwing ErrorException if the error should not be suppressed.

methods.name: exception
methods.description: Handles exceptions by logging and displaying or redirecting based on configuration settings.
